doc.name: LLMready
doc.description: Audit websites for AI search readiness and generate or validate llms.txt files. Connect over MCP (Streamable HTTP) at https://answer-engine-ready.lovable.app/mcp: quick_check is free without signing in (10 per minute and 100 per day per IP address); audit_url, get_audit, list_audits, generate_llms_txt, validate_llms_txt, get_usage need an LLMready Pro sign-in over OAuth (€19/month or €149/year). Each skill is one MCP tool. LLMready speaks MCP, not A2A messaging: this card describes the MCP server and there is no A2A task endpoint. A score measures crawler access and readability; it never guarantees AI citations.

extensions.description: How to connect: the interface is an MCP server (Streamable HTTP), not an A2A endpoint. Use an MCP client: POST JSON-RPC to the endpoint (initialize first on 2025-era protocol versions), then tools/list and tools/call. Skill ids are the MCP tool names.

authentication.note: quick_check works without signing in (10 per minute and 100 per day per IP address). Every other tool needs an LLMready Pro sign-in: calling one without a token returns HTTP 401 with a WWW-Authenticate challenge that starts OAuth.

params.pricing: quick_check is free with or without an account (rate limited). Other tools are included with LLMready Pro.

restApi.authentication: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (lr_…), created on the LLMready Pro dashboard. MCP sign-in doesn't use API keys.

quickCheck.description: The same free quick check over plain HTTPS, sharing the per-IP limits: 10 per minute and 100 per day.

oauth2SecurityScheme.description: LLMready Pro sign-in for every tool except quick_check. MCP clients find this through https://answer-engine-ready.lovable.app/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource (RFC 9728) and the 401 WWW-Authenticate challenge; dynamic client registration is listed in the authorization server metadata. No specific scopes are required.

skills.name: Quick AI search readiness check (free)
skills.description: MCP tool `quick_check`. Free, no sign-in needed: checks a public website live and returns its 0–100 AI search readiness score, grade, category scores, which AI crawlers robots.txt allows or blocks, whether llms.txt exists, and the top 3 fixes. Limited to 10 checks a minute and 100 a day per IP address (per account when signed in). Saves no report.
examples: Is example.com ready for AI search?

skills.name: Audit a website for AI search readiness
skills.description: MCP tool `audit_url`. Crawls a public website live and scores how well ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude can access and read it: 0–100 score, grade, category scores, every failing check, prioritized fixes and a shareable report link. Requires an LLMready Pro sign-in (OAuth). Costs 1 credit.
examples: Run a full AI search readiness audit of https://example.com

skills.name: Get a saved audit
skills.description: MCP tool `get_audit`. Fetches a saved audit from the signed-in LLMready account by id, including score, failing checks, AI crawler access and fixes. Requires an LLMready Pro sign-in (OAuth). No credit cost.

skills.name: List your audits
skills.description: MCP tool `list_audits`. Lists audits saved on the signed-in LLMready account, newest first, optionally for one domain. Requires an LLMready Pro sign-in (OAuth). No credit cost.
examples: Show my last 5 audits for example.com

skills.name: Generate llms.txt and llms-full.txt
skills.description: MCP tool `generate_llms_txt`. Crawls a website's key pages and generates a spec-compliant /llms.txt plus an /llms-full.txt with page content as Markdown, ready to upload to the site root. Requires an LLMready Pro sign-in (OAuth). Costs 1 credit.

skills.name: Validate an llms.txt file
skills.description: MCP tool `validate_llms_txt`. Checks llms.txt content, or a site's live /llms.txt, against the llmstxt.org proposal and lists errors and warnings by line. Requires an LLMready Pro sign-in (OAuth). No credit cost.
examples: Is the llms.txt on example.com valid?

skills.name: Check API credits
skills.description: MCP tool `get_usage`. Shows how many LLMready credits the signed-in account has used and has left this month. Requires an LLMready Pro sign-in (OAuth). No credit cost.
examples: How many LLMready credits do I have left?
